document.name: Ballet in the Bronx
document.shortDescription: Hunts Point Alliance for Children offers Ballet in the Bronx, an after-school dance program in Hunts Point for 2nd through 6th grade scholars with ballet, modern dance, and anatomy instruction.
document.longDescription:
Hunts Point Alliance for Children's official Ballet in the Bronx page says the program provides a holistic, rigorous, and culturally relevant dance experience for children in Hunts Point. The page says 2nd through 6th grade scholars learn the fundamentals of ballet, modern dance, and human anatomy to build an understanding of form, function, and movement.

The official page says scholars are taught by professional instructors from Dance Theatre of Harlem and that classes occur three days a week from 2:30 p.m. to 5:30 p.m. during the school year. The program includes two community showcase performances each year, one in December and one in June.

The organization's footer lists 1231 Lafayette Avenue, The Bronx, NY 10474, with phone (718) 620-2824 and email info@hpac10474.org. The public page reviewed does not publish tuition information.

Sources: https://www.huntspoint.org/balletinthebronx https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5d4488914df5da0001ddaa0e/f5a2e62e-c807-4826-be67-cbf6c530aeae/BalletinTheBronx.jpg?format=1500w
